items.p: Demographic shifts occur slowly, so there is a long runway before India loses its ‘youthful’ profile. But being aware of how the arithmetic is changing is crucial to rework policy priorities.

items.p: The seasonally adjusted index fell to 54.7 in October from 55.1 in September and remained below the flash figure readings of 54.9. But the index was comfortably above the neutral mark of 50 and its long-run average.

items.h: Why India faces three balancing acts—and why they are tough to achieve
items.p: India faces critical economic trade-offs: balancing fuel affordability against market price signals, optimizing interest rates for household savers versus borrowers, and offering tax incentives for foreign capital while preserving fiscal stability.

items.h: India's festive demand is uneven as inflation, price hikes weigh on shoppers
items.p: While consumer demand remains resilient across consumer categories, demand shows signs of stress in pockets due to inflation from the West Asia war.

items.h: Imports, low base power fastest GST growth in four years in October
items.p: October marked the fourth month in the current fiscal year in which GST collections topped the  ₹2 trillion mark. The 23% year-on-year growth in the gross mop-up was driven by a surge in import-related taxes and a favourable low statistical base from last year.
